title: Business Owner’s Policy (BOP): A US Small Business Guide
description: A business owner’s policy bundles property, general liability and business income cover for small US firms. Who qualifies and what it leaves out.
intro: A BOP packages the core covers most small US businesses need, usually commercial property, general liability and business income, into one policy that’s often cheaper than buying each separately.

image.alt: Small lamp shop storefront with a bicycle parked on the cobbled pavement

rows: Commercial property · General liability · Business income (interruption).
Small, lower-risk businesses such as shops, offices, cafés and service firms; eligibility depends on size and industry.
Workers’ comp, commercial auto, professional liability, health insurance.
Equipment breakdown, data breach, hired and non-owned auto, employee dishonesty.
Trade “packages” for shops, offices and salons.

sections.html:
• Property: your building (if owned), equipment, inventory and furniture.
  • General liability: bodily injury and property damage to others, products and completed operations, personal and advertising injury.
  • Business income: lost income and extra expenses after covered property damage.
A BOP doesn’t include workers’ compensation, commercial auto, professional liability (E&O) or meaningful cyber cover. Flood and earthquake are typically excluded, as with homeowners policies.

sections.h2: Is a BOP right for you?
sections.html: BOPs suit businesses with modest premises and revenues and lower-risk operations. Higher-risk trades, large premises or specialist activities may need separate commercial package policies. Insurers set their own eligibility rules, so compare a few.

faqs.q: Does a BOP include workers’ comp?
faqs.a: No. Workers’ comp is a separate policy and is required in almost every state once you have employees.

faqs.q: Can home-based businesses get a BOP?
faqs.a: Some can, though home-based businesses with small exposures may be better served by a home business endorsement or in-home business policy. See home business insurance.

faqs.q: Is a BOP available in the UK?
faqs.a: Not by that name. UK insurers sell similar packages for shops, offices and trades.
